name: NTE web apps
install:
set -euo pipefail
if ! ls /usr/lib/postgresql/*/bin/initdb >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo apt-get update
  sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y postgresql
fi
npm ci
npm ci --prefix nte-command-center
start:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Boots the NTE API and the network desk. INVITE_CODE is used only when the
# environment already provides it. This file does not contain a code or secret.
set -euo pipefail
cd /workspace

PORT="${PORT:-4000}"
CORS_ORIGINS="${CORS_ORIGINS:-http://localhost:5179,http://127.0.0.1:5179}"

port_open() {
  curl -sf -o /dev/null --max-time 2 "http://127.0.0.1:${1}${2}"
}

ensure_session() {
  local name="$1" port="$2" path="$3" cmd="$4"
  if port_open "$port" "$path"; then
    echo "$name already listening on $port"
    return 0
  fi
  if tmux has-session -t "$name" 2>/dev/null; then
    tmux kill-session -t "$name"
  fi
  local exports
  exports="PORT=$(printf %q "$PORT") CORS_ORIGINS=$(printf %q "$CORS_ORIGINS")"
  if [ -n "${INVITE_CODE:-}" ]; then
    exports="$exports INVITE_CODE=$(printf %q "$INVITE_CODE")"
  fi
  tmux new-session -d -s "$name" -c /workspace -- \
    bash -lc "export $exports; exec $cmd"
  echo "started $name"
}

wait_for() {
  local name="$1" port="$2" path="$3"
  local i
  for i in $(seq 1 90); do
    if port_open "$port" "$path"; then
      echo "$name ready on $port"
      return 0
    fi
    sleep 1
  done
  echo "$name did not become ready on $port" >&2
  tmux capture-pane -pt "$name" -S -80 >&2 || true
  return 1
}

ensure_session nte-server 4000 /api/health "npm run dev:server"
ensure_session network-desk 5179 / "npm run dev --workspace=apps/network-desk -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5179 --strictPort"
wait_for nte-server 4000 /api/health
wait_for network-desk 5179 /
echo "network desk demo is ready"
